journey.title: Recovery Journey
journey.subtitle: Your hemoglobin over time, against your own anemia cutoff
journey.recoverySubtitle: Computed by a rule engine from your serial hemoglobin readings
journey.recoveryValidation: Validated on {{journeys}} labeled synthetic recovery journeys — {{missed}} cases where a slower-than-expected rise was missed. The engine withheld a forecast in {{withheld}} of them: it only estimates a recovery time when the data supports one. Thresholds are rule-based (no AI guessing) and tied to:
journey.forecastBody: at the typical response to iron replacement, hemoglobin would reach your {{target}} g/dL target in about {{weeks}} weeks.
journey.forecastCaveat: A typical-response estimate, not a promise — your actual course may differ. It assumes iron treatment is being taken.
journey.mixedBasis: Your anemia cutoff changed between these reports (for example after a profile or pregnancy update). The line shown is your most recent cutoff — earlier readings were compared against a different one.
journey.needSecond: A trajectory needs at least two blood reports. Upload a follow-up CBC to see whether your hemoglobin is rising.
journey.emptyBody: Upload a blood report to start tracking your hemoglobin over time.
